scripts.predev: npm run packages:build && npm run runtime:generate
scripts.build: npm run packages:build && npm run open-learning:generate && npm run build:web
scripts.build:web: npm run runtime:generate && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log vinext build && node scripts/prune-browser-only-ssr-assets.mjs
scripts.test: npm run packages:test && npm run build:web && npm run test:performance && npm run test:app
scripts.open-learning:generate: node packages/course-kit/bin/latent-learning.mjs schema public/open-learning/learning-pack.schema.json && node packages/course-kit/bin/latent-learning.mjs schema public/open-learning/learning-feed.schema.json --feed && node packages/course-kit/bin/latent-learning.mjs build examples/open-learning/reliable-llm-changes/learning-pack.json --out-dir public/open-learning/reliable-llm-changes && node scripts/generate-open-learning-public-docs.mjs
scripts.open-learning:schema: node packages/course-kit/bin/latent-learning.mjs schema docs/learning-pack.schema.json && node packages/course-kit/bin/latent-learning.mjs schema docs/learning-feed.schema.json --feed
scripts.validate: npm run boundaries && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.artifacts:record-training: npm run build --workspace @latent/model-lab && npm run build --workspace @latent/training-replay && node scripts/generate-recorded-training.mjs
